name_en: Dry Mala Xiang Guo - Te La (Extra Spicy)
technical_notes: Heavy beef tallow/palm oil + Pixian doubanjiang + chili oil coat; 100% of adhered oil/paste is ingested.

name_en: Dry Mala Xiang Guo - Da La (Big Spicy)
technical_notes: High chili oil + Sichuan peppercorn oleoresin + fermented bean paste.

name_en: Dry Mala Xiang Guo - Zhong La (Medium Spicy)
technical_notes: Standard Singapore Mala Xiang Guo benchmark (~1,257 kcal total bowl with ingredients).

name_en: Dry Mala Xiang Guo - Wei La (Mild Spicy)
technical_notes: Reduced chili oil ladle (~25g oil) while keeping aromatic spices.

name_en: Dry Mala Xiang Guo - Shao You Shao Yan Wei La (Less Oil/Salt)
technical_notes: Best dry option: halves oil ladle and cuts doubanjiang/MSG by 45%.

name_en: Dry Non-Spicy - Jiang Xiang (Fermented Bean Fragrant)
technical_notes: Zero chili heat, but heavy sweet bean/oyster/soy sauce glaze drives high sodium.

name_en: Dry Non-Spicy - Suan Xiang (Garlic Herb Stir-Fry)
technical_notes: Minced garlic + scallion oil stir-fry; lower sodium than Jiang Xiang.

name_en: Dry Toss - Mala Ban (Blanched + Sesame/Chili Dressing)
technical_notes: Ingredients boiled in water then tossed in sesame paste + vinegar + chili oil; higher unsaturated fat from tahini.

name_en: Soup Malatang - Classic Spicy Beef Tallow Broth
technical_notes: Full pot has 3,200mg sodium & 51g fat; skimming oil & leaving 65% broth unconsumed cuts intake to ~182 kcal & 1,120mg sodium.

name_en: Soup Malatang - Spicy Pork Bone Collagen Mala
technical_notes: Signature Yang Guo Fu / Gong Yuan emulsified bone broth + chili oil (~137 kcal & 928mg sodium if 35% broth consumed).

name_en: Soup Malatang - Non-Spicy Rich Tomato Broth
technical_notes: High lycopene & potassium; lowest saturated fat among rich soups (~74 kcal & 788mg sodium if 45% consumed).

name_en: Soup Malatang - Non-Spicy Pork/Chicken Collagen Broth
technical_notes: High collagen protein, zero capsaicin, moderate saturated fat (~86 kcal & 752mg sodium at 40% broth intake).

name_en: Soup Malatang - Non-Spicy Wild Mushroom & Herbal Broth
technical_notes: Top health-policy benchmark base: 95 kcal full pot (~38 kcal & 568mg sodium at 40% broth consumption).

name_en: Soup Malatang - Pickled Vegetable (Suan Cai) / Tom Yum / Laksa
name_zh: 酸菜金汤/冬阴功/叻沙汤
technical_notes: Suan Cai has low fat but high pickled brine sodium (2,950mg); Laksa adds coconut milk saturated fat.
